finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base, donor and uniform advantage is excluded under writer resampling but remains unresolved under crossed writer/prompt resampling; pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods. All primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor useful advantage is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling, and pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods, while all residual intervals include zero. Raw base useful advantage is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling; raw performance is worse than base only under writer resampling. Raw pooled and donor useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods, with their intervals including zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Sparse histories, calibration-selected rank, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, epoch ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
